$comment: The console session id a handoff carries (T-0617): "show it on my desktop". jarvis-core
(api/common.device_handoff) checks it before it pushes `jarvis_handoff`, the desktop agent
(aura_desktop/channel.py) before it passes it to the app, and the app
(src-tauri/logic/src/protocol.rs) before it puts it in the console's `?session=`. Each end
checks it because the id goes into a URL: the frame carries an id, never an address, so a
handoff can't point a desktop at another origin. aura-core/tests/test_device_status.py,
aura-desktop/tests/test_visible.py and protocol.rs's tests all read this table.
